description: AUTHORITATIVE historical financials for any US public company. Source: SEC XBRL filings (the official numbers companies file, not third-party scrapes). Send the company as `cik`, that argument takes a TICKER ("AAPL") or a CIK ("320193"), and `ticker` / `ticker_or_cik` are accepted as aliases for it, plus the metric as `concept` (alias `metric`), which takes a friendly name: Revenue, NetIncomeLoss, Cash, LongTermDebt, EarningsPerShareDiluted. The tool resolves the right XBRL tag for that filer (post-ASC-606 companies use RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax instead of "Revenues", etc.). Returns both ANNUAL (10-K) and QUARTERLY (10-Q) values by default, each labeled with fiscal_period and form, newest first, PLUS a `latest` field holding the single freshest data point. Every row also carries `period_start`/`period_end`/`duration_days` so the window a value covers is never ambiguous. Q4 rows are DERIVED (FY minus Q1-Q3, marked derived:true) because SEC filers never report a standalone Q4 fact, so "revenue Q4 2024" questions are answerable directly from `values`, and they are kept under period:"quarterly" too, where `latest` is the derived Q4 once the 10-K is in. Every derived row carries `derivation` ("fy_minus_quarters" exact, "fy_minus_quarters_approximate" for per-share earnings because share counts move, "ytd_minus_prior_ytd" for a quarter taken from cumulative figures); as-filed rows carry no `derivation`. If a Q4 cannot be derived (a quarter missing, a ratio or weighted-average unit that does not add, or a per-share figure whose fiscal year and quarters sit on different bases across a stock split: code split_in_year). A derived per-share Q4 is checked against the recorded stock splits; if that lookup fails on a call, those rows carry `split_check`: "unavailable" and the body declares `coverage` {complete:false}, so retry rather than trust them as checked) none is fabricated and `q4_not_derived` says why. Every as-filed row also says whether its figure was later restated: `restated` is true when a later filing reports the same period with a DIFFERENT number (a re-report of the same number is false), and `first_filed` ({value, form, filed, accession}) is the earliest filing's fact, while `value`/`form`/`filed`/`accession` stay the latest filing's. Derived rows carry `restated` true if any input was restated. `limit` caps the rows returned (newest first, after all derivation and filtering) and the response states `total_periods` and `returned`. To reproduce a past report exactly, pass `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD): only facts filed on or before that date are used, so a later restatement cannot change it. Every row has `duration`: "quarter", "ytd", "fy", "instant" (balance-sheet) or "other". `latest` with no period filter is the newest fact of any span, so it can be the FY total; `latest_quarter` is the newest discrete quarter, derived Q4 included, whatever the calendar. Under period:"quarterly", `annual_values` holds the FY rows, not quarterly ones. CASH-FLOW-STATEMENT concepts (OperatingCashFlow, Capex and siblings) are filed CUMULATIVELY by most filers, a 10-Q's six-month figure is reported under the SAME period label the discrete quarter would use. Those rows are labeled `fiscal_period` "H1" (six months) or "9M" (nine months) with `ytd:true`, never "Q2"/"Q3" bare, and a discrete-quarter sibling (`derived:true`, e.g. Q2 = H1 minus Q1) is added alongside so "capex Q2" is still answerable without presenting the six-month total as a quarter. Income-statement lines (Revenue, NetIncomeLoss) are usually filed quarter-only already and are unaffected. For one specific period, pass `fiscal_year` and/or `fiscal_period` as ARGUMENTS and the values array comes back filtered to it (they are also the names of the fields on each returned row, which is what to match on if you ask for every period instead); do not default to `latest` for a period question. Use `latest` for point-in-time metrics like cash, runway, and debt, it is the newest 10-Q when one is more recent than the last 10-K, so a stale annual figure never masks a newer quarter; for a YTD-shaped concept, `latest` prefers the discrete derived quarter over the as-filed cumulative figure, so it is never silently a 2-3x-too-large number. Use for "what was AAPL's revenue in 2024", "NVDA's latest cash position", "show me long-term debt trend", anything where you need the SEC-filed number rather than an estimate. A retired or reassigned ticker returns found:false with empty_reason ticker_not_current and the nearest company-name candidates, never a different company.

as_of.description: Optional date, YYYY-MM-DD: return each period's figure as it was KNOWN on that date, using only facts filed on or before it. A period first filed after as_of is absent, a figure restated after as_of shows its earlier value, and derived rows (Q4 = FY minus Q1-Q3, quarters taken from YTD) and `latest` / `latest_quarter` are computed from those facts only. Echoed back as `as_of`. A date before the filer's first filing of this concept returns empty_reason "as_of_before_first_filing" with `earliest_filed`. Omit for the current figures.

cik.description: REQUIRED (or one of its aliases `ticker` / `ticker_or_cik`). Ticker (e.g., "AAPL") or CIK number (e.g., "320193"). Tickers are auto-resolved.

concept.description: REQUIRED (alias `metric`). Metric name. Common: "Revenue" / "Revenues", "NetIncomeLoss", "Cash", "Assets", "Liabilities", "StockholdersEquity", "EarningsPerShareDiluted", "LongTermDebt", "SharesOutstanding" (newest cover-page count, dei; for a filer with several share classes the answer also carries `share_classes`, one row per class from the filing's cover page with its count, date, accession and listing, plus `share_classes_total` only when every class has a count; `coverage_bound` flags `latest` only when the per-class counts are more than 100 days newer and differ in value), "Capex", "OperatingCashFlow", "ResearchAndDevelopment", "SGA", "CostOfRevenue", "DilutedShares", "PublicFloat". Exact us-gaap or dei tag names also work.

fiscal_period.description: Optional filter: return only rows for this period within the fiscal year, "FY" (annual), "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4" (derived: FY minus Q1-Q3), "H1" (six-month year-to-date, cash-flow-statement concepts only), or "9M" (nine-month year-to-date). Combine with fiscal_year for a single figure. Asking for "Q2"/"Q3" on a concept this filer reports cumulatively returns the DERIVED discrete quarter, not the H1/9M total.

fiscal_year.description: Optional filter: return only rows for this fiscal year, e.g. "2024". This is the filer's OWN fiscal year label (NVDA's FY2024 ended Jan 2024), not a calendar year. Unmatched years are reported with the years that ARE available rather than as an empty result.

limit.description: Optional: return at most this many rows in `values` (and `annual_values`), newest first, a whole number from 1 to 1000. Omit for every row (the default, unchanged). The cut is made AFTER derived Q4 rows, the one-row-per-period collapse, `as_of` and the fiscal_year/fiscal_period filters, so limit 1 under period "quarterly" is the derived newest quarter. `latest` and `latest_quarter` ignore it. The response states `total_periods` (rows before the cut) and `returned`, so a short history is distinguishable from a truncated one.

metric.description: Alias for `concept`, the word this tool's own description uses for the thing you are asking about.

period.description: Which reporting periods to return: "all" (default, annual 10-K + quarterly 10-Q), "annual" (10-K/20-F/40-F only), or "quarterly" (discrete quarters: 10-Q facts plus the derived Q4, no 10-K rows in `values`). Point-in-time metrics (cash/runway/debt) usually want the default so the freshest quarter is included; use "annual" for clean year-over-year trends.

ticker.description: Alias for `cik`, same thing, a ticker or a CIK. Declared because sibling SEC tools name this argument differently (edgar_fund_holdings uses `ticker`, edgar_company_filings uses `ticker_or_cik`) and a caller filling arguments from prose reaches for whichever it read; all three spellings work here.

ticker_or_cik.description: Alias for `cik`, the spelling used by edgar_company_filings, edgar_insider_transactions and edgar_product_revenue.

name: edgar_company_concept

annual_total_periods.description: Rows annual_values held before limit cut it. Present only when limit cut annual_values.

annual_values.description: Annual values sorted by fiscal year descending

period_end.description: Period end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

split_check.description: Present only on a derived per-share Q4 row when the stock-split lookup failed on this call, so the row was not checked against recorded splits and may mix share bases. Absent when the lookup ran.

as_of.description: Echo of the as_of argument (YYYY-MM-DD) when one was passed: every row was built only from facts filed on or before it.

candidates.description: Nearest company-name matches (ticker, company_name, cik); name guesses, not the company asked about

candidates_tried.description: Present when reported is false: the XBRL tag names looked up.

company_name.description: Official company name; null when SEC returns no entity name for the filer.

coverage.description: Present only when the answer is knowingly incomplete. complete is false when the stock-split lookup failed, in which case derived per-share Q4 rows carry split_check "unavailable". The gateway surfaces it as _meta.shortfall.coverage and does not cache the response (complete false and transient true).

transient.description: true: the incompleteness is transient (retry gives a checked answer), so the gateway does not cache this response.

earliest_filed.description: Present with empty_reason as_of_before_first_filing: the date of the earliest filing that reports this concept.

empty_reason.description: ticker_not_current: the symbol matched only a company name, so nothing was looked up

found.description: false when the ticker is not a current SEC ticker (retired or renamed); see empty_reason and candidates

latest.description: Freshest data point (any span; can be the FY total with no period filter). Under period:quarterly it is the newest quarter including a derived Q4. null, never zero, when no current value exists: reported is false (the filer reports no matching tag, or only a stale one, see stale_tag) or empty_reason is as_of_before_first_filing.

derivation.description: How a derived row was computed. Absent on as-filed rows. fy_minus_quarters_approximate is per-share earnings, an estimate because share counts move.

derived.description: true when computed (Q4 = FY minus Q1-Q3, or a quarter taken from cumulative figures), false when filed as is

first_filed.description: The earliest filing that reported this period, as first filed. value/form/filed/accession on the row itself stay the LATEST filing. Absent on derived rows.

fiscal_period.description: FY | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | H1 | 9M

restated.description: true when a later filing reports this same period with a different number than the first filing did; a re-report of the same number is false. Derived rows: true if any input was restated.

split_check.description: Present only on a derived per-share Q4 row when the stock-split lookup failed on this call, so the row was not checked against recorded splits and may mix share bases. Absent when the lookup ran.

latest_quarter.description: Newest discrete quarter, derived Q4 included; null when the concept has none, always under period:annual, and when no value exists (reported false).

derivation.description: How a derived row was computed. Absent on as-filed rows. fy_minus_quarters_approximate is per-share earnings, an estimate because share counts move.

derived.description: true when computed (Q4 = FY minus Q1-Q3, or a quarter taken from cumulative figures), false when filed as is

first_filed.description: The earliest filing that reported this period, as first filed. value/form/filed/accession on the row itself stay the LATEST filing. Absent on derived rows.

fiscal_period.description: FY | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | H1 | 9M

restated.description: true when a later filing reports this same period with a different number than the first filing did; a re-report of the same number is false. Derived rows: true if any input was restated.

split_check.description: Present only on a derived per-share Q4 row when the stock-split lookup failed on this call, so the row was not checked against recorded splits and may mix share bases. Absent when the lookup ran.

limit.description: Echo of the limit argument, present only when one was passed.

period.description: The period filter applied: all, annual or quarterly.

predecessor.description: Present when SEC records this CIK as the successor registrant to another: names the predecessor beside the unchanged values. Series are never merged.

q4_not_derived.description: Recent fiscal years where no Q4 could be derived, with the reason. Present only when there is something to say.

rejected_tags.description: Present when a balance-sheet request found only income-statement or cash-flow tags, which are not returned as the answer.

reported.description: Present as false when no current value exists for the concept (latest is null and values is empty); see note and empty_reason.

share_classes.description: Present on a share-count request for a filer whose newest 10-K/10-Q cover page states its count per class. One row per class on the cover.

class.description: Class name as the cover gives it

listed.description: True only if the cover's registered-securities table has a row for the class

reason.description: Present when value is null: why there is no count

value.description: Cover count in shares; null when the cover names the class but states no count

share_classes_filing.description: The filing whose cover page was read

share_classes_on_cover.description: Class names listed on the cover page

share_classes_status.description: Present only when the cover-page read failed

share_classes_total.description: Present only when every class on the cover has a count: their sum. A share count, not a market-cap input.

stale_tag.description: Present when the freshest tag the filer publishes stops more than three years back; latest stays null rather than serving that figure.

succession_check.description: Present when the successor check could not establish or complete an answer for a short history; says why.

ticker.description: The ticker that was asked about

total_periods.description: Rows that matched every filter before limit cut anything. Equals returned when no limit was passed.

values.description: Rows for the requested period, newest first

derivation.description: How a derived row was computed. Absent on as-filed rows. fy_minus_quarters_approximate is per-share earnings, an estimate because share counts move.
